source_title: Etsy Etsy Q4 2025 Earnings Call Transcript

snippets.snippet_text: "Notably, our trailing twelve-month active buyer count in the United States increased slightly from Q3 to Q4, and US buyer GMS grew 0.3% year over year, marking the first quarter of positive growth in four years."
"Our personalized owned marketing programs are doing a better job engaging, with push and email clicks up more than 25% while message volume stayed disciplined."
